name: Thumbtack
description: Thumbtack is integrated into Claude to help you take action on home projects. Ask questions about repairs, maintenance, or improvements and get matched with local pros. From leaky faucets to landscape design, we've got pros for every home project. Browse recommendations and connect with the right pro, making it easier to go from project planning to hiring without leaving the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Thumbtack to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Thumbtack to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.thumbtack.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Thumbtack MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Thumbtack scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Thumbtack MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Thumbtack provides these MCP tools: Search_home_service_pros, filter_home_service_pros, get_reviews_for_pros, and get_category_recommendations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Thumbtack?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Thumbtack in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Thumbtack does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Thumbtack failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Thumbtack scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Thumbtack is developed by Thumbtack. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
